python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import re, os, sys, json
TS = re.compile(r"^\[(\d{4}-\d\d-\d\dT[\d:.]+Z)\]")
base = os.path.expanduser("~/.factory/logs/")
for name in ["droid-log-single.log.2026-10-24.1", "droid-log-single.log.2026-10-24.2", "droid-log-single.log"]:
    p = base + name
    if not os.path.exists(p): continue
    turns = []  # (pos, sec ts)
    allts = []
    maxgap = 0.0
    prev = None
    from datetime import datetime
    with open(p, errors="replace") as f:
        for line in f:
            m = TS.match(line)
            if not m: continue
            t = m.group(1)[:19]
            allts.append(t)
            if prev and t < prev:
                g = (datetime.fromisoformat(prev) - datetime.fromisoformat(t)).total_seconds()
                maxgap = max(maxgap, g)
            if not prev or t > prev: prev = t
            if "[Agent] Streaming result" in line and '"sessionId"' in line:
                turns.append((len(allts)-1, t))
    # candidate ends: every turn ts
    affected = 0; total = 0; worst = 0; example = None
    ends = sorted(set(t for _, t in turns))[::7]
    for end in ends:
        total += 1
        # first index with ts > end
        cut = next((i for i, t in enumerate(allts) if t > end), len(allts))
        want = sum(1 for _, t in turns if t <= end)
        got = sum(1 for i, t in turns if i < cut and t <= end)
        if want != got:
            affected += 1
            if want - got > worst:
                worst = want - got; example = (end, want, got)
    print(name, "max_backward_gap_s=%.0f" % maxgap, "ends_tested=%d" % total, "ends_with_dropped_turns=%d" % affected, "worst=%d" % worst, "example=%s" % (example,))
PYEOF
